availability.note: CarExpert 12 Nov 2026: MY27 A5 line-up keeps the e-hybrid quattro 270kW Sedan and Avant; 150kW TFSI dropped, 200kW TFSI customer-order only; 220kW e-hybrid not confirmed for AU. Cars24 MY27 report agrees. audi.com.au returned 403 to automated reads on 2026-11-26, so the configurator was not read.

listPrice.note: MY27 A5 e-hybrid quattro 270kW Sedan $89,900 before on-road costs (CarExpert 12 Nov 2026; Cars24 MY27 'before on-road costs'); Audi AU magazine (manufacturer) 'starts at $89,900'; carsales $89,900 'before on-road costs' with drive-away guide $96,582-101,840, so not a drive-away figure.

batteryKwh.note: usable; Audi press release 25.9 kWh gross / 20.7 kWh net; Audi Germany data sheet (07/2026) 25.9 / 20.7; CarExpert review 20.7 usable

rangeKm.note: Audi AU magazine: up to 97 km WLTP, Sedan, 20-inch wheels standard. Matches the bottom of Audi's original WLTP band 97-107 km (CarExpert reveal table). Audi Germany's July 2026 sheet shows a re-homologated EAER band 103-118 km; not adopted as no AU source quotes it.

combinedRangeKm.note: 97 + 46 L / 7.3 × 100 = 727.1; 46 L tank per Audi data sheet and CarExpert review

fuelConsumptionL100km.note: Audi WLTP 'fuel consumption with discharged battery' 6.5-7.3 L/100km for the 270kW Sedan; top of band taken for the AU 20-inch spec, consistent with the AU 2.6 L/100km label also being top of band. Chasing Cars measured 7.6 (Avant) engine-running. Audi Germany July 2026 sheet gives 6.9-6.2 for a re-homologated car.

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined CO2 ≤ 120 g/km; Audi AU magazine and carsales give 60 g/km

bootLitresSeatsUp.note: Audi 331-1,175 L for the e-hybrid Sedan (VDA); Audi AU magazine 331 / 1,175; Audi Germany data sheet 331 / 1175. CarsGuide's 311 is a typo.

bootLitresSeatsDown.note: Audi AU magazine 1,175 L seats folded; same on Audi press release and data sheet

seats.note: 5 seats; Audi data sheet body 5 doors / 5 seats

towKg.note: Changed from held 1,900. Audi Germany data sheet (07/2026) 'trailer load 8% / 12% gradient, braked' 1900 / 1700; Audi's Australasian sheets quote the 12% figure (Audi NZ RS 5 sheet: 1,900 kg braked at 12%, = the German 12% column), and carsales lists 1,700 kg braked for the AU e-hybrid. Held 1,900 was the 8% figure from Audi's global press release ('up to 1,900').

depreciationCurve.note: Audi brand curve, matched to audi-q4-e-tron by owner convention (one curve per brand); held [1,0.66,0.54,0.46,0.39,0.33] differed by 0.01 in years 1-2

availability.note: CarExpert 10 Nov 2026: RS5 range 'has hit Australia', one grade as Sedan or Avant; Cars24 MY27 A5 report lists RS5 V6 PHEV Sedan $179,900. Avant excluded (wagon). audi.com.au configurator returned 403.

listPrice.note: Audi AU magazine (manufacturer, 14 Apr 2026): RS 5 Sedan from $179,827* (asterisk unexplained on the page). batteryKwh.note: usable; Audi RS 5 Sedan data sheet (linked from this page, 07/2026) 'Gross / net battery capacity 25.9 / 22.0'; Audi NZ MY26 spec sheet 25.9 / 22.0

consumptionKwhPer100km.note: batteryKwh / rangeKm × 100 = 22.0 / 78 × 100 = 28.2. Audi's 17.7-18.4 kWh/100km is utility-factor weighted and not used.

combinedRangeKm.note: 78 + 48 L / 10.0 × 100 = 558; 48 L tank per Audi data sheet and CarExpert review

isGreenForVicDuty.note: SRO green passenger car: combined CO2 ≤ 120 g/km; Audi weighted combined CO2 86-98 g/km (audi.com RS 5 Sedan page), whole band under 120. AU label CO2 not found.
